preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is between 1 and 30 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= 30000 and 1 <= c <= 4 and 1 <= q <= 300000 for n, c, q in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, n is between 1 and 30000, c is between 1 and 4, and q is between 1 and 300000.

preconditions.expression: all(len(p) == n and set(p) == set(range(1, n+1)) for p in permutations)
preconditions.description: Each permutation p contains exactly n distinct integers from 1 to n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= i <= n and 1 <= j <= 10**18 for i, j in queries)
preconditions.description: For each query, i is between 1 and n, and j is between 1 and 10^18.
The sum of n over all test cases does not exceed 300000, and the sum of q over all test cases does not exceed 300000.

postconditions.description: The number of output lines equals the total number of queries across all test cases.

postconditions.expression: all((j > len(generate_permutations(p, c)) and line == '-1') or (j <= len(generate_permutations(p, c)) and line == str(generate_permutations(p, c)[j-1][i-1])) for line, (p, c, i, j) in zip(output_lines, all_queries))
postconditions.description: For each query (i, j) on permutation p with cost limit c, if j exceeds the count of obtainable permutations, output -1; otherwise, output the i-th element (1-indexed) of the j-th permutation in the lexicographically sorted list of all permutations obtainable by exactly one reversal operation with cost <= c.
